title: 1255. Maximum Score Words Formed by Letters

examples.explanation: Score  a=1, c=9, d=5, g=3, o=2 Given letters, we can form the words "dad" (5+1+5) and "good" (3+2+2+5) with a score of 23. Words "dad" and "dog" only get a score of 21.
Score  a=4, b=4, c=4, x=5, z=10 Given letters, we can form the words "ax" (4+5), "bx" (4+5) and "cx" (4+5) with a score of 27. Word "xxxz" only get a score of 25.
Letter "e" can only be used once.
